meta.001: Shared truckload freight across Ethiopia and East Africa. SharedTrucks matches compatible shipments with available vehicle space so businesses share transport costs.
meta.002: SharedTrucks Logistics — Ship your freight. Share the cost.
meta.003: Compatible freight. Shared transport costs. A connected network for shipments across Ethiopia and East Africa.
copy.005: We match small, medium and large shipments with available vehicle space across Ethiopia and East Africa. Compatible loads share a route, a vehicle and the transport cost.
access.003: Three separate groups of freight sharing the cargo space of a single truck
copy.007: Shipments travelling the same route on a compatible schedule can move together. We check that the goods can safely share space and coordinate pickups and deliveries without moving them through a consolidation terminal.
copy.008: Share transport costs with other businesses shipping along the same route. Move a smaller order without paying for an entire vehicle.
copy.009: Transport providers fill available space on outbound and return journeys. Better matched loads help reduce empty running and make each trip more productive.
copy.010: Our technology brings vehicle availability, open capacity and planned routes into one view across our transport network.
copy.011: Our team uses that information to find suitable space, bring compatible loads together and coordinate each shipment. That includes making better use of return journeys.
copy.020: Vehicle and route updates help us plan each shipment.
copy.021: The goods, route and shipment size determine the vehicle. Our network includes courier cars, cargo vans, medium trucks and large freight trucks.
